recognize_zh: 組織切片中成片的組織球細胞質內塞滿許多細小、大小一致的圓形小體，每顆周圍有淡色空暈（halo），夾雜淋巴球與纖維間質，這種「組織球內滿是小酵母菌」的樣子是組織胞漿菌症的特徵。
features: Sheets of histiocytes with abundant granular to bubbly eosinophilic cytoplasm
Cytoplasm packed with numerous uniform tiny round to oval bodies (about 2-4 um) with clear halos
Histiocyte nuclei oval and vesicular, displaced by the organisms
Admixed small lymphocytes and plasma cells in fibrous stroma
No well-formed necrotizing granulomas in this field
describe_en: Tissue section shows effacement by sheets of histiocytes with abundant granular cytoplasm distended by numerous small, uniform, round-to-oval intracellular organisms surrounded by clear halos. Scattered lymphocytes and plasma cells are present in a fibrous background, and well-formed necrotizing granulomas are not seen in this field. Findings are consistent with disseminated histoplasmosis (Histoplasma capsulatum); confirmation with GMS or PAS stains, culture, antigen testing, and assessment of immune status are recommended.

ddx.vs: Leishmania amastigotes have a bar-shaped kinetoplast next to the nucleus and are GMS/PAS-negative.
Talaromyces yeasts are more elongated and divide by fission with a central transverse septum rather than budding.
Tachyzoites are crescentic and lack a halo, and they are GMS-negative.
C. glabrata yeasts are slightly larger with budding and no halo, and Pneumocystis cysts are extracellular in foamy alveolar exudate.
